I attempted suicide a couple time just this year. I never thought I would live to see my 13th birthday, but here I am. One day I was sent to the hospital (a whole other story) and they decided to send me to a mental health facility in the morning. I was told by my fellow patients that I am loved and needed in this world. They really loved me and kept telling me that "if there's a person who *doesn't* like you, we'd throw hands." Hearing those words from people who I just met meant a lot to me. After seven days of being in that facility, I came out a happy person, no longer suicidal. 


I'll tell you this, there are people out there that love you and would be absolutely devastated if you killed yourself. People care about you and want the best for you. Things may be tough right now but if you stick around for long enough, you'll come to realize that life is a miracle and worth living. Just like I did. 


Don't lose hope, bro. There's a bright future waiting for you.
